hints.title: Allowed Character Set
hints.text: Store the allowed characters in a lookup set or bitmask for constant time lookups.

hints.title: Verify Word Characters
hints.text: For each word, check if every character exists within the allowed character set.

hints.title: Tally Consistent Words
hints.text: Increment the counter for each word whose characters are all allowed.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: L is total characters across words
k is size of allowed set (<= 26)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching allowed string linearly for every character takes O(L * |allowed|) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space set or bitmask checks character membership in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement fast membership check using hash set or 26-bit mask.
